purpose: Exact immutable-history compatibility for V2 taskbooks whose semantic body sections predate current heading names. Waivers are nonoperational evidence adapters only and cannot suppress metadata, lineage, taskbook-path, Git-blob, parse, publication-authority, placeholder, or any non-heading integrity failure.

Its Git blob is frozen; compatibility therefore recognizes only these aliases for this exact publication/blob while keeping the publication nonoperational and all other integrity rules fail-closed.
